title: Integral restriction and normalized completion transport
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $D=(k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], an algebraic closure $\Omega$ and an embedding $E\hookrightarrow\Omega$ [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Let $X_0$ be separated and of finite type over $k_0$, and let $j_0:U_0\hookrightarrow X_0$, $i_0:Z_0\hookrightarrow X_0$ be complementary open and closed immersions [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Their base changes, specified coefficient functors and mate predicates are those of [def-sf-open-closed-weil-mate-data]. Then sfIntegralOpenClosedWeilMateAssertions D l E j₀ i₀ ∧
    sfCompletionOpenClosedWeilMateAssertions D l hl E j₀ i₀. Its notions and specified comparisons use [def-weil-frobenius-detailed], [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], [def-weil-derived-direct-image], [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate], [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data], [def-sf-integral-open-operations], [def-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison-data], [def-pod-integral-completed-comparison-data], [def-zl-field-weil-shriek-shift-data], [def-zl-common-stage-weil-shriek], [def-zl-frobenius-compact-support-comparison], [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-pullback], [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-open-square], [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-open-adjunction], [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-direct-adjunction], [def-sp-coefficient-mate-comparisons], [def-sp-open-coefficient-adjunction-data], [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category], [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower].

proof.text: Use integralSupportFunctorNormalization for the four preservation clauses. Identify completed direct images using their coefficient-map homEquiv and derived natural isomorphism; uniqueness of left adjoints identifies the closed pullbacks. Geometric Frobenius pullback is an equivalence of the ringed-site derived categories, giving both mate isomorphisms. The mate unit/counit formulas prove the ordinary integral assertion. Combine with the separate strict completion normalization theorem.

theorem sf_openClosed_weil_integral_stage
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    (_ιE : E →ₐ[Padic l] Ω)
    {X₀ U₀ Z₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom] [IsSeparated X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType U₀.hom] [QuasiCompact U₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Z₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Z₀.hom]
    (j₀ : U₀ ⟶ X₀) (i₀ : Z₀ ⟶ X₀)
    [IsOpenImmersion j₀.left] [IsClosedImmersion i₀.left]
    (_hij : Set.range i₀.left.base = (Set.range j₀.left.base)ᶜ) :
    sfIntegralOpenClosedWeilMateAssertions D l E j₀ i₀ ∧
    sfCompletionOpenClosedWeilMateAssertions D l hl E j₀ i₀
